title: I also could’ve added Broadway Flea, Romeo and Juliet first preview a...
transcript: this was a hard one to nail down this is three fun theater things I did this week I was invited to opening night at the Met to see grounded a new opera by jeanine tesori & george brant directed by michael mayer it was so much fun to just dress up and go to the opera it felt very fancy, very bridgerton I'm new to opera but grounded is a contemporary opera in english about drone warfare and I've never seen anything like it this week I was also invited to new york theatre workshop for a sneak peek of ‘we live in cairo’ a new musical about student activists during the arab spring to be honest this show was not really on my radar but after seeing this preview I cannot wait to go. the music is beautiful the story is so important and this cast is incredibly talented and yes if you saw tommy that is ali louis bourzgui.incredible. we live in cairo starts next week october 9th get your ticket and finally this week I was also invited back to kit kat club to see the brand new cast auliʻi cravalho as sally bowles adam lambert as the emcee and calvin leon smith as cliff I am obsessed with this cast auli’i might be my favorite sally I have ever seen she and calvin have incredible chemistry and adam especially in the second half devastated me if you've already been it is definitely worth the return trip what a great week of theater
